{{Quote|All these Muuns, they hate each other. But one thing unites them&mdash;they hate Kenuun more.|Unidentified Glymphid Podracer|<ref name="Target" />}}
This '''unidentified individual''' was a [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] who resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]].<ref name="Target" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Glymphid was among the five podracers who raced against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who ultimately won the [[Muunilinst Podrace|race]] on the outskirts of [[Pilaan]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of Muunilinst.<ref name="Target" />
